requirements.text: Develop a [REDACTED] configuration page in the admin area so an admin user can configure the [REDACTED] settings for email configuration.
Each application in the grid must display an Approve button.
Each application in the grid must display a Reject button.
Only admin users shall have permission to Approve or Reject applications.
The Approve and Reject buttons must not be visible to non-admin users.
When an admin user approves an application, an approval email must be sent to the recipient's emailId from the users table.
The approval email must have the subject 'Application Approved'.
The approval email body must include application details containing the ID and [REDACTED].
When an admin user rejects an application, a rejection email must be sent to the recipient's emailId from the users table.
The rejection email must have the subject 'Application Rejected'.
The rejection email body must include application details containing the ID and [REDACTED].
The [REDACTED_LOCATION] field in the [REDACTED]'s table must be updated with StatusID 112 when an application is approved.
The [REDACTED_LOCATION] field in the [REDACTED]'s table must be updated with StatusID 113 when an application is rejected.
